# 1 Chronicles Chapter 9 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 375v–376r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/1CH_009_page_001.jpg, 1CH_009_page_002.jpg

---

**9:1** And-all Yisra'el were-enrolled-by-genealogy [hityachsu], and-behold they [are] written upon the-book [sefer] of-the-kings of-Yisra'el. And-Yehudah was-exiled [haglah] to-Bavel for-their-treachery [bema'alam].

**9:2** And-the-first inhabitants [ha-yoshvim ha-rishonim] who [were] in-their-possession [ba-achuzzatam] in-their-cities [were] Yisra'el, the-priests [ha-kohanim], the-Leviyyim [ha-leviyyim], and-the-Netinim [ha-netinim].

**9:3** And-in-Yerushalayim dwelt from the-sons of-Yehudah, and-from the-sons of-Binyamin, and-from the-sons of-Efrayim and-Menasheh:

**9:4** Utai son of-Ammihud son of-Omri son of-Imri son of-Bani, from the-sons of-Perets son of-Yehudah. **9:5** And-from the-Shiloni: Asayah the-firstborn and-his-sons. **9:6** And-from the-sons of-Zerach: Ye'u'el, and-their-brothers — six hundred and-ninety.

**9:7** And-from the-sons of-Binyamin: Sallu son of-Meshullam son of-Hodavyah son of-ha-Senu'ah, **9:8** and-Yivneyah son of-Yerocham, and-Elah son of-Uzzi son of-Mikhri, and-Meshullam son of-Shefatyah son of-Re'u'el son of-Yivniyyah. **9:9** And-their-brothers according-to-their-generations — nine hundred and-fifty-six. All these men [were] heads of-fathers according-to-the-house of-their-fathers.

**9:10** And-from the-priests: Yedayah, and-Yehoyariv, and-Yakhin, **9:11** and-Azaryah son of-Chilqiyyah son of-Meshullam son of-Tsadoq son of-Merayot son of-Achituv, prince [nagid] of-the-house of-God [beit ha-Elohim], **9:12** and-Adayah son of-Yerocham son of-Pashchur son of-Malkiyyah, and-Ma'asai son of-Adi'el son of-Yachzerah son of-Meshullam son of-Meshillemit son of-Immer. **9:13** And-their-brothers, heads of-the-house of-their-fathers — one thousand seven hundred and-sixty, mighty-ones of-strength [gibborei chayil] for-the-work [limle'khet] of-the-service [avodat] of-the-house of-God.

**9:14** And-from the-Leviyyim: Shema'yah son of-Chassuv son of-Azriqam son of-Chashavyah, from the-sons of-Merari, **9:15** and-Baqbaqqar, Cheresh, and-Galal, and-Mattanyah son of-Mikha son of-Zikhri son of-Asaf, **9:16** and-Ovadyah son of-Shema'yah son of-Galal son of-Yedutun, and-Berekhyah son of-Asa son of-Elqanah, the-one-dwelling in-the-villages of-the-Netofati.

**9:17** And-the-gatekeepers [ha-sho'arim]: Shallum, and-Aqqub, and-Talmon, and-Achiman, and-their-brothers; Shallum [was] the-head. **9:18** And-until now [ve'ad hennah] at-the-gate of-the-king [sha'ar ha-melekh] to-the-east — they [are] the-gatekeepers for-the-camps [machanot] of-the-sons of-Levi.

**9:19** And-Shallum son of-Qore son of-Evyasaf son of-Qorach, and-his-brothers of-the-house of-his-father, the-Qorachim [Korahites], over the-work [ha-mela'khah] of-the-service [ha-avodah], keepers [shomrei] of-the-thresholds [ha-sippim] of-the-tent [ha-ohel]; and-their-fathers [were] over the-camp [machaneh] of-YHWH, keepers of-the-entrance [ha-mavo]. **9:20** And-Pinechas son of-El'azar [was] prince [nagid] over-them formerly [lefanim]; YHWH [was] with-him.

**9:21** Zekharyah son of-Meshelemyah [was] gatekeeper [sho'er] of-the-entrance [petach] of-the-tent of-meeting [ohel mo'ed].

**9:22** All of-them, the-chosen-ones [ha-berurim] as-gatekeepers at-the-thresholds — two hundred and-twelve. They in-their-villages [bechatsereihem] were-enrolled-by-genealogy [hityachsu]; them David and-Shemu'el the-seer [ha-ro'eh] established [yissdu] in-their-trust [ba-emunatam]. **9:23** And-they and-their-sons [were] over the-gates of-the-house of-YHWH, the-house of-the-tent [beit ha-ohel], as-guards [le-mishmarot].

**9:24** To-the-four winds [ruchot] were the-gatekeepers: to-the-east, to-the-west [yammah], to-the-north [tsafonah], and-to-the-south [negbah]. **9:25** And-their-brothers in-their-villages [were] to-come for-seven days, from-time to-time [me'et le'et], with-them.

**9:26** For in-trust [ba-emunah] they [were] — the-four mighty-ones [givrorei] of-the-gatekeepers — they [were] the-Leviyyim, and-they-were over the-chambers [ha-leshakhot] and-over the-treasuries [ha-otserot] of-the-house of-God. **9:27** And-around the-house of-God they-would-lodge [yalinu], for upon-them [was] the-guard [ha-mishmeret], and-upon-them [was] the-key [ha-mafteach], and-morning by-morning [la-boqer la-boqer] [they would open].

**9:28** And-from-them [were those] over the-vessels [kelei] of-the-service [ha-avodah], for by-count [be-mispar] they-would-bring-them-in [yevi'um] and-by-count they-would-take-them-out [yotsi'um]. **9:29** And-from-them [were those] appointed over the-vessels [ha-kelim] and-over all the-vessels of-the-holy [ha-qodesh], and-over the-fine-flour [ha-solet] and-the-wine [ha-yayin] and-the-oil [ha-shemen] and-the-frankincense [ha-levonah] and-the-spices [ha-besamim]. **9:30** And-from the-sons of-the-priests [were] the-mixers [roqchei] of-the-mixture [ha-mirqachat] of-the-spices.

**9:31** And-Mattityah from the-Leviyyim — he [was] the-firstborn of-Shallum the-Qorachi — in-trust [ba-emunah] over the-work [ma'aseh] of-the-flat-cakes [ha-chavittim]. **9:32** And-from the-sons of-the-Qehati, from-their-brothers, over the-bread of-the-arrangement [lechem ha-ma'arekhet], to-prepare [lehakhin] Shabbat by-Shabbat [shabbat be-shabbat].

**9:33** And-these [are] the-singers [ha-meshorerim], heads of-fathers of-the-Leviyyim, in-the-chambers [ba-leshakhot] set-free [peturim]; for day and-night upon-them [was] the-work [ba-mela'khah].

**9:34** These [were] heads of-fathers of-the-Leviyyim, according-to-their-generations, heads — these dwelt in-Yerushalayim.

**9:35** And-in-Giv'on dwelt the-father of-Giv'on, Ye'i'el, and-the-name of-his-wife [was] Ma'akhah. **9:36** And-his-son the-firstborn [was] Avdon, and-Tsur, and-Qish, and-Ba'al, and-Ner, and-Nadav, **9:37** and-Gedor, and-Achyo, and-Zekharyah, and-Miqlot. **9:38** And-Miqlot fathered Shim'am. And-also they, opposite their-brothers, dwelt in-Yerushalayim, with-their-brothers.

**9:39** And-Ner fathered Qish, and-Qish fathered Sha'ul, and-Sha'ul fathered Yehonatan, and-Malkishu'a, and-Avinadav, and-Eshba'al. **9:40** And-the-son of-Yehonatan [was] Meriv-Ba'al, and-Meriv-Ba'al fathered Mikhah.

**9:41** And-the-sons of-Mikhah: Piton, and-Melekh, and-Tachrea, and-Achaz. **9:42** And-Achaz fathered Ya'ra, and-Ya'ra fathered Alemet, and-Azmavet, and-Zimri. And-Zimri fathered Motsa. **9:43** And-Motsa fathered Bin'a, and-Refayah his-son, El'asah his-son, Atsel his-son.

**9:44** And-to-Atsel [were] six sons, and-these [are] their-names: Azriqam, Bokhru, and-Yishma'el, and-She'aryah, and-Ovadyah, and-Chanan. These [were] the-sons of-Atsel.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "for their treachery":** The keyword *ma'al* again — the same term used in 5:25. The exile of Judah to Babylon is attributed to a single cause: covenant treachery.

**v.2 — "the Nethinim":** Temple servants (*netinim* = "given ones"), probably of foreign origin, dedicated to tabernacle/temple service. They appear prominently in Ezra-Nehemiah but rarely in Chronicles.

**v.17-27 — The gatekeepers:** An elaborate description of the gatekeeper system — four directional stations, rotating shifts, responsibility for keys, vessels, supplies, and security. This reflects the post-exilic temple's administrative structure projected back onto David's arrangements.

**v.22 — "David and Samuel the seer established them":** The gatekeeping system is given dual authorization — by David (the king who organized temple service) and Samuel (the prophet-seer). This dual foundation in royal and prophetic authority legitimates the system.

**v.33 — "set free" (peturim):** The singers are *peturim* — exempt from other Levitical duties because their work of praise requires full-time devotion, day and night.

**v.35 — Jeiel:** Here the name of Gibeon's father is supplied (*Ye'i'el*), absent from the parallel in 8:29.

*— EMET*
